# proxcenter_blueprints (Data Source)

Blueprints the token may deploy (source.blueprint of a proxcenter_vm). Needs a VM scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxcenter_blueprints" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `blueprints` (Attributes List) The blueprints. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--blueprints))

<a id="nestedatt--blueprints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `blueprints`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the blueprint.
- `id` (String) Identifier to use as source.blueprint.
- `image_slug` (String) Catalogue image the blueprint deploys.
- `name` (String) Display name.
